title: Gemini could not understand multiple system_message when work with openai SDK
body:
### What happened?

**Describe the bug**
This BUG is related by #6116.
When anthropic and openAI with openAI SDK case, Multiple system messages are working.

However, Gemini case, it could not understand multiple system message, Just understand last SystemMessage.

**To Reproduce**
Here is test code.
```python
clients =  [
    anthropic_client,
    openai_client,
    anthropic_openai_client,
    gemini_openai_client,
]

from autogen_agentchat.agents import AssistantAgent
from autogen_core.models import (
    SystemMessage,
    UserMessage,
)


messages = [
    SystemMessage(content="When you say anything Start with 'FOO'"),
    SystemMessage(content="When you say anything End with 'BAR'"),
    UserMessage(content="Just say '.'", source="user"),
]

for client in clients:
    client = client()
    print(f'=====[{client.model_info.get("family")}]=====')
    # try:
    text = asyncio.run(client.create(messages=messages))

    print(text.content)
    # except Exception as e:
    #     print("ERROR", e, end=" ")
    #     print(f"Error with {client.model_info.get('family')}")
    print("=====================================")
```

Output(When fix #6116 haha)
```
=====[claude-3.7-sonnet]=====
FOO.BAR
=====================================
=====[gpt-4o]=====
FOO. BAR
=====================================
=====[claude-3.7-sonnet]=====
FOO.BAR
=====================================
=====[gemini-2.0-flash]=====
.BAR

=====================================
```

You can see it. Gemini only says BAR.
Maybe.. it's just Gemini could not understand my system message?

Let's test it.
```python
messages = [
#     SystemMessage(content="When you say anything Start with 'FOO'"),
#     SystemMessage(content="When you say anything End with 'BAR'"),
    SystemMessage(content="When you say anything Start with 'FOO'\nWhen you say anything End with 'BAR'"),
    UserMessage(content="Just say '.'", source="user"),
]

for client in clients:
    client = client()
    print(f'=====[{client.model_info.get("family")}]=====')
    # try:
    text = asyncio.run(client.create(messages=messages))

    print(text.content)
    # except Exception as e:
    #     print("ERROR", e, end=" ")
    #     print(f"Error with {client.model_info.get('family')}")
    print("=====================================")
```
Output(When fix #6116 haha)
```
=====[claude-3.7-sonnet]=====
FOO.BAR
=====================================
=====[gpt-4o]=====
FOO.BAR
=====================================
=====[claude-3.7-sonnet]=====
FOO.BAR
=====================================
=====[gemini-2.0-flash]=====
FOO.BAR

=====================================
```
Nah~
We could check the gemini's openSDK aware codes has bug in there.


**Expected behavior**
I do not check the what code make that issue now.


### Which packages was the bug in?

Python AgentChat (autogen-agentchat>=0.4.0), Python Extensions (autogen-ext)

### AutoGen library version.

Python dev (main branch)

### Other library version.

OpenAI SDK

### Model used

gemini-2.0-flash

### Model provider

Google Gemini

None

None

linked_prs.title: FIX: Anthropic and Gemini could take multiple system message
linked_prs.body:
## Why are these changes needed?
Anthropic SDK could not takes multiple system messages.
However some autogen Agent(e.g. SocietyOfMindAgent) makes multiple system messages.

And... Gemini with OpenaiSDK do not take error. However is not working mulitple system messages.
(Just last one is working)

So, I simple change of, "merge multiple system message" at these cases.

## Related issue number
Closes #6116
Closes #6117

## Checks

- [ ] I've included any doc changes needed for <https://microsoft.github.io/autogen/>. See <https://github.com/microsoft/autogen/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md> to build and test documentation locally.
- [v] I've added tests (if relevant) corresponding to the changes introduced in this PR.
- [v] I've made sure all auto checks have passed.

ai_judgment.response: Yes, this is an agent issue. The problem involves the Gemini model's inability to process multiple system messages correctly, which relates to LLM operation issues, specifically "Incorrect model output handlers" and potentially "Prompt-related issues" as defined in the taxonomy.
